messages:
riley: well that was a first my succulent decided my ethernet was a watering can and now my internet is sad. pic: https://imgur.com/succulent-saga

mona: oh noooo 622 unplug the router for 30s, then plug back in. sometimes the capacitor tantrums after moisture.

devin: if still flaky try a different port on the switch/router, and test with `ping -c 10 8.8.8.8`.

riley: did a full power cycle, then swapped ports. `ping` looks okay but packet loss spikes at random. ISP chat said no issues.

mona: temporary workaround: tether and schedule a weekend window to deep clean. or use an inline PoE injector if applicable.

ops-bot: FYI: If this impacts customer traffic, run `redwood incident create --source home-network` and tag @oncall.

riley: planning a professional dry-and-swap. also reshuffling the desk so the plants are now on island time. :palm_tree: thanks for the tips and sympathy 60a

devin: vote: desk rearrange livestream? react with :camera: if you want a mini tour.

mona: :camera: i'll bring tea.

riley: :camera: scheduled for Saturday 11am PST. no live demos of succulents attacking hardware promised.

ops-bot: Reminder: label spare cables and keep a 1m patch cable in the tech drawer.
